d: Launched in Bahrain in November 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We provide better, faster, and more accessible ways to enjoy nutritious food through technology-driven kitchens. CALO operates high-performance cloud kitchens focused on consistency, speed, and quality, delivering healthy meals at scale.

We are looking for a Chef De Partie – Bakery to join our team, working alongside the Head Chef to manage the bakery section. This includes preparing baked goods, ensuring consistent quality and presentation, maintaining inventory, and supervising junior bakery staff. For this role, we are seeking candidates with a strong bakery background and creativity in pastry, breads, and desserts. The successful candidate will use their culinary and managerial skills to play a key role in elevating our bakery offerings and maintaining exceptional standards.

Ability to assign responsibilities and monitor progress effectively.
Up-to-date with bakery trends, techniques, and optimized kitchen processes.
Pleasant personality with the ability to lead with empathy and patience.
Customer service mindset, passionate about quality and innovation in bakery products.

d: Schedule: Full-time, aligned with Eastern Time business hours
Compensation: C$35,000–C$45,000 annually, including base pay and performance bonuses

MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Customer Retention Specialist to manage existing property-owner relationships, overcome objections, sell appropriate services, and keep active leasing files moving toward a successful outcome.

This is not a basic customer-service position. You must be comfortable challenging unrealistic expectations, recommending actions clients may initially resist, and asking owners to make clear decisions.

Direct real-estate experience is preferred but not required. Strong candidates from account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, insurance, SaaS, financial services, telecommunications, staffing, hospitality, automotive sales, or another service-based industry are encouraged to apply.
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email within 24–48 hours with a link to complete a short prerecorded video interview.
The interview includes realistic sales and client-objection scenarios. Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live interview.
Manage multiple active property-owner and leasing files.
Keep owners informed about listing activity, showings, feedback, applications, and offers.
Identify why a property is not attracting sufficient interest or qualified applicants.
Use market information and showing feedback to recommend reasonable price changes.
Present qualified tenant offers and persuade owners to make timely decisions.
Sell professional photography, video, cleaning, repairs, and other appropriate services that may improve leasing performance.
Explain the financial effect of continued vacancy.
Handle objections while protecting the owner’s trust.
Recover dissatisfied or at-risk client relationships.
Secure owner cooperation with keys, lockboxes, property access, cleaning, and listing requirements.
Address conflicting or unauthorized advertising during an exclusive agreement.
Coordinate with owners, tenants, realtors, vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, follow-ups, and next steps.
Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns when required.
Three or more years of experience in account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, leasing, property management, portfolio management, or another client-facing role.
Experience managing ongoing client relationships—not only completing one-time sales.
Demonstrated ability to overcome objections and persuade clients to act.
Experience retaining dissatisfied clients or recovering difficult relationships.
Confidence recommending price changes, services, or property improvements.
Experience upselling relevant services or solutions.
Ability to use evidence, feedback, market information, and financial reasoning to influence decisions.
Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management.
Experience managing multiple clients, files, transactions, or opportunities.
Experience using a CRM or structured workflow system.
Sound judgment when handling complaints, resistance, and escalations.
Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
Canadian real-estate or leasing experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
The right person combines strong relationship-management skills with the confidence of a consultative salesperson.
You must be able to listen to a client’s concern, identify the real objection, explain the evidence, recommend a practical solution, and ask for a decision.

You should be persuasive without being misleading or aggressive. You must know when to continue selling, when to enforce a company requirement, and when a legal, financial, or agreement-related concern must be escalated.
